info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort Suggestions API

items.docs: When a user edits a lookup field, use this resource to search for and display suggestions. You can search for most recently used matches, for matching names, or for any match in a searchable field. You can also specify lookup filter bindings for dependent lookups.

info.name: Salesforce Get Lookup Field Suggestions for a Specified Object

params.name: SOBJECT_API_NAME
params.description: The API name of a source object.

params.name: FIELD_API_NAME
params.description: The API name of a lookup field on the source object.

params.name: TARGET_API_NAME
params.description: The API name of the target (lookup) object.

items.docs: When a user edits a lookup field, use this resource to search for and display suggestions for a specified object. You can search for most recently used matches, for matching names, or for any match in a searchable field. You can also specify lookup filter bindings for dependent lookups.
